["Whether and when the Collective Bargaining Committee in Construction terminated before EO 12110 (effective 1978-12-31): the order's own text sets no term, so the end depends on the Federal Advisory Committee Act two-year limit (sec. 14(a)(2)) and any renewal, or on a record of the Committee's completion; no held charter, renewal notice or termination record. EO 12110 sec. 1-103(b) is a cleanup revocation of a committee it describes as terminated or completed, with no date. Bound only: ended no later than 1978-12-31."]
